summary: Grifols SA filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its third-quarter 2026 financial results release and presentation. The filing reports revenue of EUR 2,040 million for Q3, up 8.4% year-over-year at constant currency, net profit of EUR 162 million (up 27.9%), and year-to-date net profit of EUR 390 million. Adjusted EBITDA for the first nine months reached EUR 1,392 million, with a 24.8% margin. Net leverage declined to 3.98x from 4.2x a year earlier, liquidity increased to EUR 2,140 million, and no significant maturities exist until Q4 2028 following refinancing. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings report.
